pip.description: Small cream-colored bunny with one floppy (lop) ear and one upright ear, a soft ginger patch around his left eye, a short fluffy tail and big kind eyes. Wears only a mustard-yellow knitted scarf, no shirt, jacket or pajamas. Sleeps in a nest of thistledown inside the hollow of an old willow tree at the meadow's edge; the hollow has an arched opening hung with trailing willow leaves, and soft light comes from glowing mushrooms and fireflies.
pip.doNot: Never draw Pip brown or gray-brown, in anything blue, or in a jacket, shirt or pajamas. Never use an underground burrow, a round window, a lantern or a wicker basket. These together read as Peter Rabbit (Katie, 2026-11-10).
pip.note: Redesigned 2026-11-10 (Katie): the old look was too close to Peter Rabbit. The next run must generate ONE fresh reference image from this description, check it against doNot, save its Canva media id here, then pass it as imageReferences for every Pip image. Never use previousReferenceMediaId.

mama_rabbit.description: Pip's mother: same cream bunny art style, slightly larger, both ears upright, a soft ginger muzzle, wears a sage-green knitted shawl. Never brown, never in blue, never in an apron or dress.
mama_rabbit.note: No standalone reference yet. Generate from this description; do not reuse the old Pip reference.

oona.description: A gentle round owl with big kind eyes, soft brown and cream feathers, perches on a tree branch outside Pip's window at night.
oona.note: No standalone reference generated yet — introduced in story 01, appears again in story 02.

palette: Pastel twilight palette: lavender, dusky rose, sage green and warm mushroom-glow gold; sky in soft indigo. Soft painterly storybook style.
